name: Xerox / Dead air
look: A stencil poster run through a photocopier: bold black stencil shapes with bridges and keylines on white paper, cut to pure black and white, stencil type that drops letters, drawings on threes under a copy that jitters on 12; plate B is the negative of the same frame

axes.base: white copier paper; a torn toner band may take the foot of the sheet
axes.line: stencil: flat toner fills and bars with white bridges where a loop would close and a white keyline where two shapes overlap; no stroke, no pressure
axes.tone: threshold: grade { threshold: 1 } cuts every grey to toner or paper; greys are drawn only for the cut to decide (a shadow ramp, static, a grey scale)
axes.planB: the negative: the same frame under grade { invert: 1, threshold: 1 }, paper turned to toner
axes.motion: on threes (8 drawings a second, one global clock) under the copy jitter of the carrier on 12
axes.carrier: xerox: contrast 0.8, exposure 0.4, toner 0.55, dropouts 0.7, streaks 0.6, jitter 3; plate B lowers toner to 0.3 and dropouts to 0.5
axes.accent: none: the copy drops every colour
axes.font: stencil: strokeText style 'stencil', letters placed one by one so the copy can drop or misfeed them
axes.match: silhouette: the figure keeps every pixel across the cut to the negative
axes.overlays: none; a counter or a grey scale is printed matter on the sheet, not an overlay
